name: print-social-navy-economic-calendar-weekly-grid-with-flag-cards
title: Navy weekly 'Economic Calendar' grid with flag-labelled event cards and a glowing horizon
whatItIs: A portrait navy post with a 'GCM 25 years' logo, 'Economic Calendar' title and date range, a Monday–Friday column grid of dark glassy cards each showing a country flag, currency and time (USD 20:30) with the release name, a dashed 'No Event' card, and a blue glowing planet arc at the bottom.
whatItMeans: Organised and trustworthy; flags make dense trading data instantly scannable.
techniques: Lay out a week as a column grid of cards.
Tag each item with a flag and time.
Show empty slots with a dashed outline.
Use a glowing horizon to lift a data-heavy post.

vocabulary.definition: A schedule of market-moving data releases.
How a slot with no content is shown.
